inputs.text: Vertical over-phone close portrait of the same adult Chinese woman age 28. The matte black back of one smartphone fills the lower foreground, with a small rear camera module visible; the display faces only the woman and is completely hidden from camera. Her worried adult plush face remains clearly visible above the phone, eyes fixed downward and eyebrows gradually tightening. Same low ponytail, light blue shirt, charcoal blazer and thin silver necklace. Premium handcrafted 3D plush stop-motion film, fine textile fibers, cold tense light, 85mm portrait lens. Exactly one phone, rear side only, no visible screen, no interface, no fingers crossing the front, no generated text.
